sections.title: Claims and evidence
findings: Proposal document read by reasoning layer: yes
Requested: Fund a 12-month Governance Incentives Framework project to research, model, test, document, and submit a governance incentives framework for Cardano.

Deliverables: Governance Incentives Framework report, public dataset and dashboard, documented incentive models and formula outputs, controlled incentive pilot findings report, publication-ready research paper submitted for peer review, completed and submitted Governance Incentives Framework CIP, governance integration pathway and final financial/milestone reporting

Claim (governance, supported_in_proposal, high materiality): The project will evaluate candidate governance incentive mechanisms through research, data, modeling, controlled testing, and community input before presenting adoption decisions to governance.

Claim (governance, independently_verifiable, medium materiality): Existing Cardano governance incentive work includes 49 relevant efforts, proposals, research papers, tools, and initiatives mapped by the Governance Incentives Working Group.

Claim (governance, independently_verifiable, high materiality): During Cardano's first year of on-chain governance, active DReps declined in every 12-epoch period, DRep voting-power concentration increased, and 11-16 DReps represented 51% of voting power.

Claim (governance, proposer_asserted, high materiality): The proposal argues that poor incentive design could reward surface-level activity, reinforce voting-power concentration, encourage gaming, or spend treasury resources without meaningful governance value.

Claim (governance, supported_in_proposal, high materiality): The project will deliver seven staged milestones covering discovery, framework definition, data collection, modeling, dashboarding, validation, and governance integration.

Claim (adoption, supported_in_proposal, medium materiality): The proposal sets measurable KPIs including 50+ governance actors engaged, 10+ workshops, 12 monthly updates, 50+ simulation scenarios, at least 99% monitoring service availability, and 5+ dashboards.
